description_expanded: SummaryEnjoy a relaxing getaway at Shore Me the Way, a beautifully designed 4BR/4.5BA vacation rental in the sought-after Magnolia Cottages by the Sea. Just a short stroll to deeded beach access, this home offers an unbeatable location near 30A’s top spots, including Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill. Featuring a screened-in porch, spacious interiors, and complimentary bikes, it’s perfect for a family retreat.SpaceMake lasting memories with family and friends and your pet at Shore Me The Way! This newly constructed and beautifully decorated, 4BR/4.5BA home is exclusively located at the end of a quiet side street in coveted Magnolia Cottages by the Sea. This spacious, well-positioned home is tucked away between Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill, making it convenient to several boutiques, local eateries and live entertainment. Shore Me The Way also boasts an easy stroll (5 minutes) to the deeded beach access. Shore Me The Way has everything one could possibly need for a memorable stay on 30A! Sleep 10 guests comfortably with 4 king bedrooms each with an ensuite bathroom and an adorable bunk nook for your younger companions! Cocktails or coffee? The choice is yours to enjoy on the screened-in porch, positioned in the back of the home for a quiet, private retreat. Ready to explore? Walk, run or bike along the 18 mile Timpochee Trail and explore the many stores, restaurants and state parks that 30A has to offer! You will love your stay at Shore Me The Way.. to 30A! HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Large heated (Winter months depending on ambient nightly temp) neighborhood pool - Easy walk to beach access TRANSPORTATION - Bikes are popular on 30A! 6 bikes are included with this property. BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided upon request SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 10) - Primary Suite - 1st Floor: King bed, private bathroom, Walk-in shower - King Bedroom - 2nd floor: King bed, private bathroom, Walk-in Shower - King Bedroom - 2nd floor: King Bed, private bathroom, tub/shower combo - King Bedroom - 2nd floor: King bed, private bathroom, Walk-in shower - Bunk Nook - 1st floor; twin/twin bunk beds FEATURES: - 4 Bedroom/4.5 Bathroom Cottage - Sleeps 10 - Private screened-in porch in rear of home - Full Sized Washer Dryer - Fully Appointed Kitchen - Full Size Refrigerator - Full Size Oven/Stove - Beverage Refrigerator -Propane Grill - Complimentary Wifi - Large HEATED (Winter - dependent on ambient temps) Community Pool - Parking for 2 cars in driveway - Close Proximity to the beach - neighborhood is directly across 30A from beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path along 30A - Close to The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and SeasideNeighborhoodMagnolia Cottages by the Sea is a quaint, family friendly neighborhood a short bike ride away from Rosemary and Aly's Beach, as well as The Big Chill. This neighborhood also has deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood as well as 2 public beach accesses just steps from the entrance.TransitThere is parking for 2 vehicles in the driveway. There is no street parking.NotesInformation for the Pontoon Rental & Yacht Charter will be provided in the welcome packet after booking.House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted.Read Less
